## Type of Change

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Fix
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] CI or repository maintenance

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e`
- [ ] Optional backend checked when touched

## Product Checks

- [ ] French text checked
- [ ] Spanish text checked
- [ ] Light theme checked
- [ ] Dark theme checked
- [ ] Responsive layout checked
- [ ] Keyboard or screen-reader impact considered
- [ ] Screenshots or recordings added when UI changed

## Repository Rules

- [ ] No secrets or `.env` files committed
- [ ] Manually maintained source files stay at or below 300 lines
- [ ] Documentation updated for user-visible changes
